title: Unmatched Private Wine Tours for Up to 11 in Kelowna Area
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Introducing our Private Group and Special Occasion Tours, perfect for brides-to-be, birthday celebrations, or any group looking to relax and enjoy the good vibes .

Comfort, price, flexibility and our luxury Mercedes Sprinter van is the ideal choice. With spacious seating for up to 11 passengers, you'll have plenty of room to kick back and enjoy the ride. 

We'll take you on a scenic drive to the Kelowna Wine Routes where you can taste a diversity of wines and have tons of fun on the way!

Our tour will last around 4 hours. The tasting fees at each winery are included with your tour, so you won't have to worry about any additional costs. We gladly also include a free light snack during the tour.

Booking early and chatting with us to plan your special day is a guaranteed path to success. So don't hesitate to reserve your spot today! Join us for an unforgettable experience, complete with options for using your own playlists and enjoying the finest wineries the region has to offer.
